Google LLC — Data Scientist 
Role Category: Data Scientist 
 Bengaluru, India · Full-Time · ₹28,00,000 CTC Annual performance bonus and stock grants 
Role Overview 
Analyze massive datasets to extract insights, build predictive models, and support product 
and business decisions. You'll work closely with engineering and product teams to design 
experiments, evaluate metrics, and deploy data-driven solutions. 
Key Responsibilities 
• Design and run experiments (A/B tests) and interpret their results rigorously 
• Write efficient, production-grade SQL against very large datasets, including schema 
design and query optimization 
• Build and evaluate predictive models, applying sound statistical judgment 
• Partner with engineering and product teams to turn analysis into shipped features 
• Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders 
What We're Looking For 
• Strong SQL skills — writing and optimizing complex queries, understanding indexing, 
and designing a schema for event or telemetry data 
• Solid quantitative and analytical reasoning — comfortable interpreting experiment 
results, probability, and metrics under ambiguity 
• Foundational machine learning knowledge: bias-variance tradeoff, regression vs. 
classification, how gradient descent works, and how to recognize overfitting 
• Excellent communication skills — able to explain a complex model or a surprising 
result to a product manager in plain language, and defend assumptions when 
challenged 
• A track record, academic or applied, of turning a messy dataset into a clear, defensible 
insight 
Nice to Have 
Experience with a BI/visualization tool; exposure to experimentation platforms; a portfolio of 
applied data projects. 
Benefits 
Health coverage, paid parental leave, learning programs, RSUs, flexible work arrangements.
